description.zh: 奖学金、竞赛与其他荣誉记录。
记录学习与探索路上的几个里程碑。
description.en: Selected milestones from study, research, and the things I love.

description.zh: 很高兴在大三这一年再次获得这个奖学金！
description.en: I was excited to win this scholarship again as a junior!

description.zh: 我是全校唯一一名获得6000元奖学金的大二学生！
description.en: I was the sole sophomore who won the 6,000 CNY scholarship!

description.zh: 很高兴获得大一学年的奖学金！
description.en: It's great to win this scholarship for my freshman year!

title.zh: 全国大学生信息安全竞赛作品赛三等奖
title.en: Third Prize, National Information Security Competition

organization.zh: 中国信息安全评测中心
organization.en: China Information Technology Security Evaluation Center

description.zh: 我们的项目《面向神经网络的浮点计算混淆方法》获得了三等奖！
description.en: Our project "FLOB: Protecting Floating-Point Computation for Deep Neural Network Binaries with Obfuscation" won the third prize!

title.zh: 第三届电气电子工程创新大赛二等奖
title.en: Second Prize, 3rd Electrical & Electronic Engineering Innovation Competition

description.zh: 我们的项目《新型电力系统分布式协调控制器设计》获得了二等奖！
description.en: Our project "Design of a New Distributed Power Coordinated Controller" won the second prize!

title.zh: 2024年全国大学生英语竞赛三等奖
title.en: Third Prize, 2024 National English Competition for College Students

organization.zh: 高等学校大学外语教学研究会
organization.en: Foreign Language Teaching and Research Association of Chinese Universities

description.zh: 耶！我大学生涯的第一个奖项！
description.en: Yay! My first award in my college journey!

title.zh: 上海交通大学三好学生

description.zh: 很荣幸在大二这一年因表现优异和贡献突出被评为三好学生！
description.en: I was honored to be recognized as a merit student for my outstanding performance and contributions in my sophomore year!

description.zh: 很荣幸在高中阶段得到大家的认可，成为上海市三好学生！
description.en: I was recognized for my exemplary performance and contributions as a merit student in senior high school!

description.zh: 我在比赛中打男双，和搭档一起赢下了决赛的决胜局，最终赢得了冠军！
description.en: I played men's doubles in the matches, and my partner and I won the final decisive match together, contributing to our team's victory!

title.zh: MATE中国区水下机器人竞赛亚军
title.en: 🤖 Runner Up, MATE China Regional ROV Competition

description.zh: 很开心能代表母校带领水下机器人团队获得全国亚军！
description.en: I led the team and won the runner up in the MATE China Regional ROV Competition!
